result.summary: Found 2 major issues with incomplete content visibility and layout cutoffs affecting the restaurant listings.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right edge, making full content not visible
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll or card width to ensure all three restaurant cards are fully visible without horizontal clipping

issues.description: Bottom restaurant listing in 'Popular right now' section shows only the food image without the restaurant name or any identifying information visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant name and key details are visible above or below the food image, or adjust the card height so the complete listing information is shown
